summary: Two of my claims corrected and one stale status removed. (1) The normalisation is repaired: restricting to a permutation on B is justified UP TO A COMMON GLOBAL RELABELLING, not by literal equality of labelled pairs - J is invariant under the diagonal S_k action, so (piA phi, piB psi) is in J iff (phi, piA^-1 piB psi) is; membership transfers, the pairs are not identified. (2) The 'comfortable 60-second runtime for thousands of witnesses' claim is WITHDRAWN: at k=6 a blind k! traversal over 10^3 x 10^3 families is 7.2e8 tests, and even residual matching at O(k^3) leaves about 2e8 steps; the family PRODUCT is reduced by neither acceleration, so no runtime is claimed. (3) The generic null transfer has already passed locally with standard axioms, so the pending-queue language is removed. New: a pure-source packet combine/combine_witnesses.py plus fixtures.json (nine expected-outcome fixtures, hand-traced) implementing validated family inputs, pin consistency/injectivity, forbidden-cell checking, residual augmenting-path matching in place of k! traversal, and independent re-verification of the emitted colouring, with the 4-cycle negative sample as explicit expected data. Source only; syntax-checked, not executed. No result on the closed union.

verified_results.statement: CORRECTION: the normalisation of the permutation search is a statement about membership, not equality. A simultaneous relabelling rho acts by (cA,cB) -> (rho cA, rho cB) and preserves every equality and disequality, so J is invariant under the diagonal S_k action and (piA phi, piB psi) in J iff (phi, (piA^-1 piB) psi) in J. The two labelled pairs are not equal.
verified_results.grade: PROOF (invariance of J under simultaneous relabelling); supersedes my earlier 'equals'

verified_results.statement: WITHDRAWAL: the claim that the method fits comfortably in 60 seconds for families in the thousands. At k=6 a blind k! traversal over 10^3 x 10^3 families is 7.2e8 permutation tests; residual matching at O(k^3) still leaves about 2e8 elementary steps for 10^6 pairs. What remains is only the asymptotic bound O(|PhiA| |PhiB| (k^3+|I|+|E_x|)), independent of |V|, plus two accelerations (residual matching after pins reduces k! to O(k^3); signature dedupe reduces each family but not the product). No measured runtime is claimed.
verified_results.grade: self-withdrawal; the asymptotics are arithmetic, the runtime was never measured

verified_results.statement: The generic null-transfer packet has ALREADY passed a local check with standard axioms. Recorded as externally confirmed (supervisor); I did not run it and make no independent axiom claim. All pending-queue language about it is removed from this STATUS.

Packet source combine/combine_witnesses.py implements: input validation (index range, duplicates, and set equality between the identification list and the certified coincidence set), family validation (properness, shape, colour range), pin well-definedness and injectivity, forbidden-cell rejection including a pin landing in a forbidden cell, residual augmenting-path perfect matching, and an independent from-scratch re-verification of the emitted joint colouring that shares no code with the matcher.
verified_results.grade: source written; syntax-checked with py_compile only, algorithm NOT executed

verified_results.statement: Nine fixtures with expected outcomes, hand-traced: F1 the 4-cycle negative sample (two clashing singleton families, no witness, yet the union is a 2-colourable 4-cycle), F2 the same seed with one extra colouring (witness), F3 a cross edge forcing a non-identity permutation, F4 a duplicate cross edge, F5 a cross edge on an identified pair (seed not colourable), F6 a missing boundary entry, F7 an improper family member, F8 a pin landing in a forbidden cell, F9 an out-of-range index.

The distinction the packet enforces: NO_WITNESS means only that the sampled families contain no joint colouring, and must never be reported as non-colourability of the union. F1 is the standing witness of that gap, F2 shows success is monotone in the families.
No result is claimed about the closed 1048-vertex union: it remains settled (34 witnesses, all signatures distinct, no pair pinned) and is not reopened.
Nothing here is evidence of new forcing: no forced pair, no chromatic claim, no plane-level claim.

conjectures: The binding cost is the family product, not the per-pair work: after the two accelerations a pair costs microseconds, so the practical design question is how to index the families so that only pairs capable of matching a given pin are visited. Bucketing Phi_B by the value of psi at the boundary vertices would give that, and is the natural next refinement of the packet.

Completeness for a given active set would follow if the families covered every signature class on the active vertices; stating that as a coverage target when families are grown would turn the method into a decision procedure for the pinned pairs.
